column1: # critical-thinking — deterministic L2 gate (test item T-I2).
# ADDED BY open-agent-robot; not part of the upstream MIT skill. Every other file
# in this directory is the vendored original, unmodified.
# This table is the whole gate. skills/loader.py loads the SKILL.md body into a
# turn if and only if one of these phrases appears in the user's utterance. The
# model is never asked whether to load — see the module docstring for why.
#   * a phrase with no latin letters matches as a plain substring, because
#   * a phrase that starts/ends with a latin word character gets \b there, so
# Both cases are pinned by tests/fixtures/skill_triggers.tsv.
# Adding a phrase is cheap; adding one that over-fires is not. Every new phrase
# should come with a near-miss row in that fixture proving what it does NOT match.
# Honest boundary: the `yue` rows were written by a non-native speaker from the
# Cantonese forms used elsewhere in this repo. They are a starting set, not
# Columns (tab-separated):  phrase <TAB> lang   (lang ∈ zh | yue | en)
